page.title: Media
page.description: The images and videos of {workspace}, to put in posts.

uploader.title: Upload media
uploader.description: Images and videos go straight to storage. Describe each one for people who cannot see it.
uploader.dropzone: Drop images or videos here, or click to choose them.
uploader.choose: Choose images or videos to upload
uploader.accepted: JPEG, PNG, GIF and WebP images up to 16 MB, MP4 and QuickTime videos up to 1 GB.
uploader.altTextHint: What it shows, for people who cannot see it. Platforms show it with the media.
uploader.altTextWaiting: You can write it as soon as the upload starts.
uploader.altTextFailed: The description could not be saved. Try again.

errors.unsupportedType: Acme does not take this type of file. Upload a JPEG, PNG, GIF or WebP image, or an MP4 or QuickTime video.
errors.tooLarge: This file is larger than the {limit, number} MB Acme takes for its kind.
errors.altTextTooLong: The description is longer than {limit, number} characters.
errors.forbidden: You may not upload media in this workspace.
errors.signedOut: You are signed out. Sign in, then upload the file again.
errors.workspaceNotFound: This workspace no longer exists, or you no longer belong to it.
errors.network: The connection dropped while the file was being sent. Check it, then try again.
errors.linkExpired: The upload took too long and its link expired. Try again.
errors.storeRefused: The media store refused the file. Try again.
errors.storeUnavailable: The media store cannot be reached right now. Try again in a moment.
errors.incomplete: Part of the file did not arrive. Try again.
errors.rejectedSize: The file that arrived does not have the size it was sent with. Try again.
errors.rejectedType: The file’s content does not match its type: it may have been renamed, or be damaged.

probe.pending: Uploaded, and waiting to be read.
probe.unavailable: Uploaded, but this server cannot read videos, so it is not ready for posts yet.
probe.unreadable: Uploaded, but the file could not be read: it may be damaged.
probe.timedOut: Uploaded, but reading the file took too long.
probe.tooLarge: Uploaded, but the stored file is larger than declared.
probe.toolFailed: Uploaded, but the server failed to read it.

rejected.sizeMismatch: The file did not have the declared size, and was deleted.
rejected.typeMismatch: The file was not of its declared type, and was deleted.
